morphology.pattern_note: 作为外语专名整体识别，不作马来语词缀拆分。正常行文通常首字母大写；未确定具体指称，因此不填写统一读音。

senses.zh_definition: 英语专名 Loxley，可作地名或姓氏；具体所指须由上下文确定。
senses.en_definition: A proper name used for places and as an English surname; its referent depends on context.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas yang digunakan sebagai nama tempat atau nama keluarga dalam bahasa Inggeris; rujukannya ditentukan oleh konteks.
senses.nuances: 不能据此输入确定它指某一村庄、个人或机构，也不能赋予它普通马来语词义。noun 在此表示专有名词。以下为指称性组合，不是已证实的高频词汇搭配。[Loxley Parish Council](https://loxleyparishcouncil.org.uk/)；[FamilySearch：Loxley](https://www.familysearch.org/en/surname?surname=LOXLEY)

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Kat alamat ni ada nama Loxley. Nama tempat ke?

messages.zh: 这个地址里有个 Loxley，是地名吗？
messages.en: This address says Loxley. Is that a place?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Mungkin. Semak poskod dulu, baru kita tahu Loxley yang mana.
messages.ms_standard: Mungkin. Semak poskod terlebih dahulu untuk mengenal pasti tempat bernama Loxley yang dimaksudkan.
messages.zh: 可能是，先查邮编，才知道是哪个 Loxley。
messages.en: Possibly. Check the postcode first so we know which Loxley it means.

etymology.historical_story: Loxley belongs to an English tradition in which a place name also becomes a family name. A surname reference traces one example, in Warwickshire, to the Old English personal name Locc and a word meaning woodland clearing. That explanation concerns a particular naming history; it should not automatically be assigned to every place or organisation called Loxley. [FamilySearch: Loxley](https://www.familysearch.org/en/surname?surname=LOXLEY)
